module_summary: AXI-Lite read to pipelined Wishbone bridge: issues WB reads per AR request with a shadow skid register, returns acks into a FIFO tracked by first/mid/last pointers, and drains it as AXI R responses with error tracking.

anchors.name: i_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid starting a Wishbone read

anchors.name: o_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR ready dropped on stall, FIFO full or error

anchors.name: i_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address converted to word address for Wishbone

anchors.name: o_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid set on WB ack/err, cleared as FIFO drains

anchors.name: i_axi_rready
anchors.why: AXI read data accept advancing FIFO read pointer

anchors.name: o_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from FIFO at r_last

anchors.name: o_axi_rresp
anchors.why: AXI read response, SLVERR/DECERR after Wishbone error

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle held while strobe or pending acks

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone request strobe raised on AR handshake or shadow request

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone word address from AXI address or shadow r_addr

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall holding strobe and arming shadow request

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack writing returned data into FIFO

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone read data stored into dfifo

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone bus error aborting cycle and entering error state

anchors.name: dfifo
anchors.why: Read-data FIFO buffering Wishbone results for AXI R channel

anchors.name: r_first
anchors.why: Pointer of accepted AXI requests (FIFO allocation)

anchors.name: r_mid
anchors.why: Write pointer for returned Wishbone data

anchors.name: r_last
anchors.why: Read pointer for AXI responses

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag throttling arready

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error flush mode after WB error; blocks requests and sets error responses

anchors.name: err_loc
anchors.why: FIFO slot where the Wishbone error occurred

anchors.name: r_stb
anchors.why: Shadow request pending while Wishbone stalls

anchors.name: r_addr
anchors.why: Shadow address held during stall

anchors.name: wb_outstanding
anchors.why: Count of outstanding Wishbone requests awaiting ack

anchors.name: wb_pending
anchors.why: Outstanding-ack flag keeping o_wb_cyc asserted

groups.name: AXI read address front-end
groups.description: Accepts AR requests with skid shadow register when Wishbone stalls

groups.name: Wishbone master
groups.description: Issues pipelined Wishbone reads and counts outstanding acks

groups.name: AXI read response and error
groups.description: Drives R channel and propagates Wishbone errors as AXI responses
